report.summary: Food-resource options for P-D003 (67F, Original Medicare, home tract 17031440201, Cook County). Her most recent screener (2026-10-01) reported no food worry and food never ran out, but she asked for food options. Several no-/low-barrier resources are available nearby. The Harvest Table Pantry page returned an unrelated maintenance/workflow notice and was not used as a source. Tract context: high food insecurity in the area (PLACES 38.1%) and low-income/low-access flag for half-mile, so access to food pantries is relevant even though screening is currently negative.

options.name: Madison Street Community Fridge (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Open daily 8 AM-8 PM; take what you need. No ID or residency requirement stated.

options.name: Saturday Market Pantry (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Saturdays 9 AM-noon. Eligibility: Cook County residents.

options.name: Northwest Side Food Pantry (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Open Mon/Wed/Fri 12-3 PM. No ID required; fresh produce available Wednesdays.

options.name: SNAP (food stamps)
options.how_to_access: Income-based nutrition assistance; apply through Illinois DHS (ABE portal) or a local community-based assiter. Tract data shows ~41% of area households receive food stamps, suggesting broad local enrollment. Eligibility for this patient cannot be confirmed without income/asset details.
